fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) declined 8%, with target price of $1,209.75 (55.85% upside potential), as stock plunged 49% monthly following TrendForce's 2027 NAND price weakness warning.
fields.summary_ko.1: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) declined 5%, SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) declined 4%, with price decline pressure from decreased SSD orders by Chinese cloud providers despite projected 25-30% NAND bit supply increase in 2027.
fields.summary_ko.2: NAND spot prices have already declined over 20%, with TrendForce expecting 0-5% contract price decline in Q1 2027 and decline across all product categories from Q2 2027 onwards.
